messages.content:
Three independent readers read the same non-disclosure agreement (NDA) and decided whether it supports one statement (the hypothesis). They may agree or disagree, and a program has checked each of their quotes against the document. Your job is to make the final decision yourself, from the document.

<document>
<document 29 omitted, sha256 4f0d1849caa0752c>
</document>

<hypothesis>
Agreement shall not grant Receiving Party any right to Confidential Information.
</hypothesis>

<readings>
<reading id="A">
label: Contradiction
confidence: 92
reason: The NDA states that the Recipient receives no license or intellectual property rights to Discloser's CI unless expressly set forth, which is a limited grant rather than a complete absence of rights, so the hypothesis that no right is granted is contradicted by the document's own provisions that permit use (e.g., residuals and disclosure to representatives for the Purpose).
<quote check="exact">Unless expressly set forth in this NDA, Recipient does not receive any license or intellectual property rights to Discloser’s CI.</quote>
<quote check="exact">All Discloser CI remains the property of Discloser.</quote>
</reading>
<reading id="B">
label: Entailment
confidence: 80
reason: The NDA states that the Recipient receives no license or IP rights to the Discloser's CI unless expressly set forth, which supports the hypothesis, though residuals use is a limited carve-out.
<quote check="exact">Unless expressly set forth in this NDA, Recipient does not receive any license or intellectual property rights to Discloser’s CI.</quote>
</reading>
<reading id="C">
label: Entailment
confidence: 80
reason: The NDA states that CI remains the Discloser's property and that the Recipient receives no license or IP rights to it; the residuals clause does not undo this standard no-rights grant.
<quote check="exact">Unless expressly set forth in this NDA, Recipient does not receive any license or intellectual property rights to Discloser’s CI.</quote>
<quote check="exact">All Discloser CI remains the property of Discloser.</quote>
</reading>
</readings>

The readings are evidence about where to look, not votes: a majority can be wrong, and a quote marked "missing" was not found in the document. Read the relevant parts of the document yourself.

Choose exactly one label:
- Entailment: the document states or clearly implies that the hypothesis is true.
- Contradiction: the document states or clearly implies that the hypothesis is false.
- NotMentioned: the document does not address the hypothesis, or says too little to decide.

Evidence is required. For Entailment or Contradiction, give 1 to 3 quotes copied character for character from the document (no paraphrase, no ellipses), each as short as it can be while still carrying the point. They will be checked against the document. For NotMentioned, give an empty list.

Give a confidence from 0 to 100: your probability, in percent, that your label is correct. Give a one-sentence reason.

Answer only with the JSON object the response format asks for: label, confidence, quotes, reason.

content.text: {"label":"Entailment","confidence":85,"quotes":["Unless expressly set forth in this NDA, Recipient does not receive any license or intellectual property rights to Discloser’s CI.","All Discloser CI remains the property of Discloser."],"reason":"The NDA states that the Recipient receives no license or IP rights in the Discloser's CI, which remains the Discloser's property; this is the standard no-rights-granted clause, and the residuals and Purpose-based use provisions do not override it."}
